_comment: Seed data for the `companies` collection (Company Directory). Reproduces the 'seed script adds examples' feature from the design spec. Compiled from web search 2026-10-20 — companies chosen by recurring appearance across multiple 'best software companies in Bangladesh' rankings. `verified` is true only where a careers URL was confirmed directly, not guessed from a domain pattern. Verify the `false` entries before wiring into the real seed script in M2.
